purpose: PostCSS configuration required for Tailwind CSS v4 utility generation in Next.js.
ownedConcepts: SHRESTA storefront and admin visual system
businessRules: Do not remove @tailwindcss/postcss while Tailwind v4 is used.
Customer storefront and admin pages depend on generated Tailwind utilities for layout, spacing, responsiveness, and SHRESTA reference styling.
Any styling pipeline change must be validated with npm run build and browser screenshots.
